$$RP_{raw}=\sqrt{8{,}998\times9{,}171104}=9{,}084140$$

$$RP_{idx}=I(9{,}084140;m=5{,}186100;s=1{,}997839)=0{,}753967$$

$$C=\frac{1/3}{0{,}4}\times0{,}21=0{,}175000$$

$$RA=\sqrt{0{,}753967(1-0{,}175000)}=0{,}788684$$

$$RR=\log_2(0{,}753967/0{,}175000)+1=3{,}107147$$
